instructions.question: Would a translator localising this interface need to translate this string?
instructions.note: `item` is one string found in source code. Text inside {...}, {{ ... }} or ${...} is a value filled in at run time and is not translated; judge the words around it. `context` gives the file, the line and where the string sits: an element, an attribute, a call or an object key.

criteria.true: Yes when the string holds words a person reads in the interface: a label, button, heading, paragraph, message, placeholder, tooltip, alt text or accessible name.
criteria.false: No when nothing in it is wording for people: an identifier, key, class name, path, URL, query, command, pattern, format, event name, code, a number, unit or version, a brand or product name, only values filled in at run time, a string already passed to a translation function, or a log, debug or test message.
